detail.title: Bravo LT400 Rolling Laptop Table - Dark Walnut Top, Black Frame
detail.overview: The Ant Esports Bravo LT400 is a multipurpose rolling laptop table that doubles as a study desk, home office workstation or mobile computer desk, moving easily on castor wheels wherever it's needed. Its dark walnut top pairs with a sturdy black metal frame for a look that fits naturally into most home or office interiors, while the compact footprint keeps it from crowding a room. Smooth-rolling wheels with a locking mechanism let it settle firmly in place once positioned, making it just as useful next to a sofa, bed or standard desk setup. A practical, no-fuss workstation for laptops, tablets, books or everyday work-from-home tasks.
